# Adopt Go example

Go module with a `greet` package and a stdlib-only `solo` package.

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init //go/tests/fixtures/adopt-go/...
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- generate //go/tests/fixtures/adopt-go/...
bazel build //go/tests/fixtures/adopt-go/...
bazel test //go/tests/fixtures/adopt-go/...
```

Both tests pass (`greet_test`, `solo_test`).
